intent_contract.persisted_encoding: RFC8785-JCS complete intent record plus one LF
intent_contract.marker_payload_rule: ASCII sha256:<SHA-256 hex of exact persisted intent.json bytes including LF> followed by one LF

writer_state_model.intent_publication: Write, fsync, close, reopen, and verify the complete self-fingerprinted JCS+LF intent in the non-authoritative sibling .intent-staging directory before the pending directory exists; then create+fsync an empty pending directory and atomically rename the complete scratch file directly to intent.json. The pending namespace exposes only empty or complete intent, never intent.tmp or partial intent bytes.
writer_state_model.marker_publication: For marker M, only M.tmp may contain an exact prefix before M exists; write+fsync the 72-byte payload, rename-no-replace M.tmp to M, then fsync the directory. M present requires M.tmp absent. Later markers require every earlier marker.
writer_state_model.staged_file_partial_rule: Before its fsync boundary, each of canonical.old, canonical.new, promotion-record.new, and lifecycle-transition.new may independently be absent or an exact prefix of its intent-bound complete bytes. After its boundary it must be exact complete. intent.json is never partial. Any non-prefix, excess, wrong-type, or unsafe-path byte is mismatch.
writer_state_model.amendment_rollback_snapshot_completion: With exact old target retained under locks, absent canonical.old is create-new copied from target; an exact-prefix canonical.old is completed only by appending the missing target suffix; recovery fsyncs and reverifies exact fingerprint, document SHA-256, and byte length before publishing rolled-back. A crash leaves another exact prefix and retries. Create forbids canonical.old.
writer_state_model.rollback_cleanup_boundary_rule: From each exact W3-W9 rollback origin with target old/absent, first complete and fsync canonical.old for amend, then process rollback_cleanup_order_exact left-to-right. For each present name, no-follow reverify its admitted exact-prefix or exact bytes, unlink it, and fsync the pending directory before advancing; absence is an idempotent no-op. Only names in this list may be removed. A crash exposes exactly a member of the union generated by every origin and every cleanup-list prefix.
writer_state_model.rollback_marker_continuation: Only after cleanup reaches the exact create/amend rollback base may rolled-back.tmp be create-new. Every zero-through-72-byte exact prefix is writer-reachable; recovery appends only the missing suffix, fsyncs and reverifies, rename-no-replace publishes rolled-back, and fsyncs the pending directory. Published rolled-back requires its tmp, every forward marker, and every staged file absent.
writer_state_model.pending_commit_finalization: With matching committed published under .pending, exact finals, no staged output, and the intended lifecycle successor committed, reverify the exact pending terminal payload; rename-no-replace <id>.pending to <id>.committed; fsync the transaction parent; and reverify the exact terminal set. Any exact, mismatching, unsafe, or otherwise pre-existing destination, simultaneous suffix, or byte/name mismatch preserves the complete pending journal and refuses without mutation. Every exact .committed observation repeats the parent fsync before returning because prior fsync completion is not observable.
writer_state_model.pending_rollback_finalization: An exact .pending rollback terminal payload is writer-reachable after rolled-back publication. Recovery rename-no-replace moves it to .rolled-back, fsyncs the transaction parent, and reverifies the exact terminal set. Destination collision or mismatch preserves evidence and refuses. Every exact .rolled-back observation repeats the parent fsync before returning because prior fsync completion is not observable.
writer_state_model.rollback_fault_enumeration: Inject after every R0-R9 reverify, unlink, directory fsync, marker create/write/fsync/rename, terminal directory rename, and parent fsync. Repeated recovery must select exactly one predicate and reach the exact immutable terminal set; every state outside the constructed writer/recovery closure selects preserved mismatch.
writer_state_model.recovery_suffix_partition: No-directory, .pending, .committed, and .rolled-back predicates are disjoint. Only .pending may clean up, roll back, roll forward, or finalize a just-published marker. Exact terminal suffixes receive content-read-only verification and repeat the transaction-parent fsync. Every simultaneous, crossed, or other suffix/name state is mismatch and is preserved.

cross_record_bindings: promotion_id equals outputs.promotion_record record_ref basename ID and record_fingerprint-derived ID
candidate, intake, normalized-content, validation-result, profile, definition, lifecycle, observation, coverage, approval, registry, and target bindings equal the retained promotion-time observations
outputs record_fingerprint equals each loaded record identity while document_sha256 and byte_length equal its exact persisted bytes

lifecycle-transition bytes bind the selected_contract prior head/state, promotion_id, validation result, and intended resulting head/state; after commit that transition is the successor rather than requiring the prior head to remain current
amend target basis, observed current, recovery old fingerprint, old document SHA-256, and retained canonical.old bytes are exact-equal
intent fingerprint recomputes from every top-level field except intent_fingerprint; marker payload hashes the complete persisted intent.json JCS plus LF
negative_vectors: intent_fingerprint included in its own preimage
pending directory contains intent.tmp or a partial intent.json rather than only empty or one atomically published complete self-verifying intent.json
create with any non-null old/current/basis binding or amendment with any null old/current/basis binding
definition, observation, coverage, or approval set missing, duplicate, reordered, incomplete, or excess
record ref basename, semantic fingerprint, raw document SHA-256, or byte length mismatch
marker gap, marker optimism, marker payload mismatch, final marker with matching tmp, or unknown pending-directory name
staged file is not absent, exact expected bytes, or an exact prefix at the one permitted pre-fsync writer boundary
rollback cleanup state is not generated by an admitted W3-W9 origin and a prefix of the exact cleanup order, or cleanup would remove a name outside that list
rolled-back.tmp appears before the exact rollback base, is not an exact 0..72-byte marker prefix, or coexists with rolled-back
published rolled-back coexists with any forward marker/stage, has a mismatching payload, or appears under a suffix other than exact pending/rolled-back finalization
published committed pending payload encounters any pre-existing or unsafe .committed destination, simultaneous pending/terminal suffix, or terminal byte/name mismatch
canonical target is neither exact old/absent nor exact new, or currentness cannot be revalidated
